title: Visit to Orphanage: Spreading Smiles
summary: A group of volunteers visited an orphanage in Rajkiya Bal Sadan, Noida spending quality time with children.
description: A group of volunteers visited an orphanage in Rajkiya Bal Sadan, Noida spending quality time with children. The initiative focused on bringing joy, emotional support, and a sense of belonging to young hearts often deprived of companionship.
